verdict.rationale: Recruitee's feature page lists "Digital offer letters & eSignatures", which is a first-party claim of offer letters sent from the ATS with built-in e-signature. That claim is only a single heading with no detail. The API "offers" endpoints refer to job postings, not offer letters, so they do not count, and the generic templates mention (docs-19) is not tied to offer letters. missing for 10: templated offer letters with dynamic/merge fields, approval routing for offers, any documentation of how the e-signature flow works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, offers go out from the ATS — templated offer letters with dynamic fields, approval routing, and built-in e-signature
